t: You're at the south-east corner of Belgrave Square, looking at a bronze statue of Simón Bolívar, the Venezuelan statesman and military officer who lived from 1783 to 1830. It is by Hugo Daini, an Italian-born sculptor who worked mainly in Venezuela and died in 1976. He made a number of Bolívar monuments, in London, Caracas, Brussels and elsewhere. James Callaghan, then Foreign Secretary and later Prime Minister, unveiled this one in 1974.
